questions.stem: A solution has pH 2. Which statement is correct?

options.text: The concentration of OH⁻ ions is greater than H⁺ ions
The solution is strongly acidic with a high concentration of H⁺ ions

questions.explanation: A pH of 2 indicates a strongly acidic solution. Lower pH means higher H⁺ concentration. At pH 2, the H⁺ concentration is much greater than the OH⁻ concentration. Stomach acid has a pH of about 1-2.
